_note: VERSION-CONTROLLED REFERENCE ONLY. The authoritative Windsurf MCP config read at startup is ~/.codeium/windsurf/mcp_config.json. Changes here are synced to global by .windsurf/scripts/post_write_mcp_config_sync.py. Edit this file; the hook propagates to global. Cascade alignment: keep MCP definitions tool-centric; keep usage procedures in skills, invariants in rules, and deterministic health or safety checks in hooks/scripts. Prefer local-first retrieval and exact or structural lookup before broad semantic expansion.

filesystem._comment: Constitutional Rule #0: filesystem MCP scope is LOCKED to repo root only. Sovereign write territories: docs/reports/plans/, artifacts/adg/, artifacts/memory/, ops_scripts/ci/, tools/. Denominator-sensitive read paths: agentic_core/adg/schema.py, agentic_core/adg/extraction/static_scanner.py, agentic_core/runtime/lifecycle_trace_contract.py. NEVER reference C:\Users\... or .windsurf\plans\ in args.
filesystem._startup: Launcher: node .windsurf/scripts/filesystem_mcp_launcher.js resolves the server script via npm prefix -g at runtime, proxies stdio explicitly, waits for the filesystem readiness banner on stderr, and enforces a 15 second startup watchdog. No version-pinned paths. To upgrade package: npm install -g @modelcontextprotocol/server-filesystem@<new-version>, restart Windsurf. Operator note: docs/guides/filesystem_mcp_operations.md

vector_db._tuning_note: Runtime defaults (batch sizes, timeouts) live in tools/retrieval/vector_config.py. Only non-default overrides and operational required-vars (offline mode, download policy, path, model) are pinned here. Full history of pruned vars: 2026-04-22 MCP-5.

io.windsurf/mcp-playwright._note: Official Microsoft Playwright MCP (@playwright/mcp). Thin npx wrapper, no custom server file. Server name preserved as 'io.windsurf/mcp-playwright' to match Windsurf's registry-installed binding so existing tool prefix (mcp*_browser_*) stays stable. Browser session output (snapshots, console logs) lands in repo-root .playwright-mcp/ which is gitignored. The 'registry' field was removed 2026-04-27 (constitutional §27 violation — schema-rejected, was silently disabling the entry).

notion._auth: Requires NOTION_TOKEN set as a Windows OS environment variable (setx NOTION_TOKEN secret_...). The env block below passes it explicitly to the npx subprocess — do not rely on implicit inheritance. Create token at https://www.notion.so/my-integrations (Internal integration). pre_mcp_gate blocks with an actionable message when the variable is absent.

tavily._auth: Requires TAVILY_API_KEY set as a Windows OS environment variable (setx TAVILY_API_KEY tvly-...). Create key at https://app.tavily.com/home. Free tier: 1000 credits/month. pre_mcp_gate blocks with an actionable message when the variable is absent — same pattern as Notion. Package: https://github.com/tavily-ai/tavily-mcp.

context7._note: Upstash Context7 MCP — up-to-date, versioned official library documentation on demand (chromadb, FastMCP, sentence-transformers, playwright, pytorch, etc.). No API key required on free tier. CONTEXT7_API_KEY (optional) at https://context7.com/dashboard raises rate limits. Package: https://github.com/upstash/context7.

_bootstrap_env: Set AGENTIC_REPO_ROOT to your local repo root and GITKRAKEN_GK_PATH to the GitKraken CLI executable. Keep tokens in OS env vars; Windsurf supports ${env:VAR_NAME} interpolation in command/args/env/url/header fields.
